anti_overlap: fd-loop-mechanics covers whether the loop pattern structurally maps to OODARC
fd-flywheel-integration covers whether experiment data feeds Interspect
fd-self-improvement-safety covers safety invariants of the loop
decision_lens: Prioritizes findings that identify the minimum viable implementation path and mismatches between the proposed implementation and Demarch's mechanism/policy separation. Findings that would cause autoresearch logic to bleed into the wrong layer rank highest.
focus: Concrete implementation choices for a Demarch-native autoresearch capability: Clavain skill vs Skaffen built-in, MCP tool vs kernel primitive, and where the domain-agnostic/domain-specific split lands in the pillar architecture
name: fd-implementation-path
persona: A pragmatic platform engineer who evaluates build-vs-integrate tradeoffs through the lens of Demarch's 'adopt mature tools, don't rebuild' principle and the composition-over-capability architecture.
review_areas: Evaluate the proposed split (Clavain skill + Skaffen built-in or MCP tool) against PHILOSOPHY.md's mechanism/policy separation
Check whether run_experiment and log_experiment belong as new intercore primitives, a new Interverse plugin, or Clavain-local tools
Assess whether the domain-agnostic infra layer maps to a standalone Interverse plugin (e.g., 'interlab') serving 'one extension, unlimited domains'
Verify that the SKILL.md template pattern fits within Clavain's existing skill authoring conventions
Identify which of the 'not-transferable' items require the most significant Demarch-native redesign
Evaluate whether the Skaffen status bar has the necessary primitives to display autoresearch state
success_hints: The domain-agnostic loop infra maps to a standalone Interverse plugin (not a kernel primitive) consistent with standalone-first principle
The implementation path requires no new kernel primitives — only a new Clavain skill and optionally a new Interverse plugin
The mechanism/policy split is clean: loop execution (mechanism) below Clavain; optimization target and domain knowledge (policy) in the skill
task_context: pi-autoresearch is an autonomous experiment loop for the pi agent platform, assessed as 'inspire-only' for Demarch. This review evaluates which design patterns are worth porting as a Demarch-native autoresearch capability and how they integrate with the OODARC framework, flywheel mechanics, and Interspect evidence pipeline.
